meta.title: A dutch auction combined with a basket auction is refused
gaps: The available vocabulary does not expose fields or parameters to configure the conversion as both dutch and basket auction, so the decisive request cannot be guaranteed to contain that combination.
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the event and check that the event has no new round (the conversion left nothing).

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event has no new round (the conversion left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Sorry, trade with this configuration is not allowed”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event has no new round (the conversion left nothing).

plan.title: A dutch auction combined with a basket auction is refused

assert.say: the event has no new round (the conversion left nothing)
